sloka: कथम् दाशरथौ भूमौ शयाने सह सीतया ।शक्या निद्रा मया लब्धुम् जीवितम् वा सुखानि वा ॥२-५१-९॥
transliteration: katham dāśarathau bhūmau śayāne saha sītayā ।śakyā nidrā mayā labdhum jīvitam vā sukhāni vā ॥2-51-9॥

translations.english: When Rama, son of Dasaratha, sleeps on the ground with Sita how can I sleep or live or enjoy pleasures?
